entry.title: Master and internal user accounts reset on Amazon OpenSearch Service: why snapshots don't restore them, and what to prepare
entry.content: On an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain with fine-grained access control, the master user password may stop working and your internal users and role mappings may disappear. Hourly automated snapshots do not bring this data back, because the official restore procedure excludes the security system index that holds it. This article explains why, what recovery is possible, and what to prepare beforehand. It is intended for operators of such domains.
